game_title: Name Tag Match – Dungeon Stairs Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in The Kingdom – Dungeon Stairs, the castle dungeon stairwell: the baker's apprentice must handle goblin raiders while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Name Tag Match: Match floating variable name tags to the values on passing grain sacks before they reach goblin raiders.
theme: The Kingdom – Dungeon Stairs: the castle dungeon stairwell
core_gameplay_loop: In Dungeon Stairs, repeat each round: Match floating variable name tags to the values on passing grain sacks before they reach goblin raiders. Each round, goblin raiders strike the signal beacon, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the tag_matches value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the signal beacon from goblin raiders in Dungeon Stairs: keep the tag_matches meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 59-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: tag_matches drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 59-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 5 (applied tier): Name Tag Match
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how tag_matches changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against goblin raiders in Dungeon Stairs.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 59 seconds while tag_matches > 0.
